book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: 1 KORIN Korin mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge amboŋga kuyarna

content: Paulus nu Kuate tuku saŋgrimbi pasa kuklina
Tira kame, ye buk tane tugum promba Kuate tuku pasa tugusek satiŋgen ta wamdus kila ŋak ko pasa kila suŋgo ŋakmbi sa ndatiŋgen.
Ye Yesus Kristus nane nu ail kazrai mbolŋge balenaig ta ndo idusmba satiŋgen.
Ye pro tane ŋgamukŋge saŋgri kugatok kuru-kuruka piririmba minen.
Ye pasa kukliwen ta tane tuku wamdus didikam tuku ye pasa kila suŋgo ŋakmbi kukli ndawen. Ye pasa sando ken le Tukul Guwa nu pasa ta saŋgri pilena le tane son ŋginaig.
Wam ta mbolŋge taŋgine ŋgamuŋgal son taŋgo tuku wamdus kila mbolŋge mine ndakate. Kuate tuku saŋgri mbolŋge minit.
Kuate tuku mbal nane kila sugo ŋak nane ŋgamukŋge sine wamdus kila sugo niŋgeg. Wamdus kila ta kilke te mbolok kuga. Kilke te tuku sugo sugo kila kilig taŋaŋ sine kile ndakeg. Mbal ta ŋgisikamŋgaig.

Sine Kuate tuku wamdus kila kuirok minna ta te-mayokeg le nuŋe mbal ndo ismba kila pilig. Kuate nu kilke te-mayok ndana sulumba sine nu ndoŋ kilŋa ŋak minbe ŋga nu taŋamba wamdus tina ta kuirok minna.
Kuate tuku wamdus ta kilke mbolok sugo sugo nane gilai minnaig. Nane kila minnaig kande Suŋgo kilŋa saŋgri ŋak nu tumba ail kazrai mbolŋge bale ndanaig kande.
Kuate tuku kuyar pasa ande teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Kuate nu wam magenu nu tuku kume purde mbal niŋgam tuku madiniŋgina. Wam ta sugokanu o mbolŋge. Taŋgo nane ammbi kaŋger ndakade. Kilbambi ise ndakade. Wamdusmbi kamus ndaniŋgig ŋgate. Aisaia 64.4

content: Wam magenu kuirok minig ta Kuate nu nuŋe Guwambi tumsiŋgit. Nuŋe Guwa nu Kuate tuku wamdus ŋakmba kila minmba sine kila sasiŋgit.
Taŋgo nu ande tuku wamdus kila mine ndakate. Nu nuŋe miroŋ ndo nuŋe wamdus kila minit. Taŋamba ndo ande nu Kuate tuku wamdus kila mine ndakate. Nuŋe Guwa taŋge ndo kila minit.
Kuate tuku wamdus ta taŋgo tuku wamdus taŋaŋ kuga. Kuate nu wam sugo piya kugatok siŋgina ta nu nuŋe Guwa siŋgit taŋge tumsiŋgit.
Ta tuku nu wam sugo piya kugatok siŋgina ta taŋgo tuku wamdus kila tambi sine kukli ndaweg. Tukul Guwaŋge tumsiŋgit le kukliweg. Kukliweg le Tukul Guwa ŋak mbal pasa ta ismba katesede.
Tukul Guwa kugatok minig mbal nane Kuate tuku Guwa tuku wam kame talaka ŋginŋgan wam ndo ŋga nane katesewam kumuŋ kuga. Tukul Guwa ŋak mbal ndo nuŋe wam kame pileŋga alonu kamusmba katesede.
Nane wam ŋakmba pileŋga pitik katesede. Tukul Guwa kugatok mbal nane Tukul Guwa ŋak mbal kumumbi pileniŋgam kumuŋ kuga.

content.text: Ima nu Suŋgo tuku wamdus kila minit?
Ima nu Suŋgo wam paguwam kumuŋ ŋgate. Aisaia 40.13

content: Pasa ta son. Sine Kristus tuku ndo kila mineg.
